gen-dafont-college-gf-duru-sans: College draws a heading whose outline you could trace with one finger, every curve as thick as its stems, with big open counters. Duru Sans sits underneath as a plain sans, low and wide, with hardly any ascenders showing.
gen-dafont-college-gf-fresca: Fresca takes the lower line with short ascenders over big bowls, and its counters stay linked to the space outside them. Next to College's weighty display letters, a longer read feels loose and unhurried.
gen-dafont-college-gf-funnel-sans: College leads with big, heavy letters. Funnel Sans is the better one for the paragraph work, with its steady strokes and an e that opens wide, while College owns the loud moments.
gen-dafont-college-gf-gafata: Every curve in College is cut to the depth of its straight stems, like an engraver's single pass, with tall roomy lowercase. Gafata, a sans-serif with short stalks and wide-eyed e shapes, sits lower and quieter beneath it.
gen-dafont-college-gf-geist: College gives every curve the same heft as its stems, so its tall lowercase looks almost stamped out. Geist follows in a sans that moves along level and quiet, its words forming solid blocks under the louder heading.
gen-dafont-college-gf-gidole: College is cut with curves as heavy as its stems. Gidole counters with a neon-tube consistency, its terminals held apart like open scissor blades, and that tidy restraint is what makes the pairing work.
gen-dafont-college-gf-golos-text: Golos Text fills the line with a tall x-height and a widely parted s, drawn from a single stroke width. Shrink College down and its heft loses the punch, while blowing up the body would only crowd it.
gen-dafont-college-gf-hedvig-letters-san: Hedvig Letters Sans leaves a clear gap where its c ends, and its small letters stand nearly as tall as capitals. And College adds a ruler-straight line weight above, which is where this pair gets its strength.
gen-dafont-college-gf-heebo: College gives its o equally thick sides and top, a ring of constant weight. Heebo's tall central band and curves that stop short instead of closing make a paragraph feel open and easy to move through.
gen-dafont-college-gf-hind-guntur: Authoritative is the mood College sets, with every curve as heavy as a stem and big counters throughout. And Hind Guntur follows as a plain sans with wide gaps at the curve ends, so long paragraphs stay light on the eye.
